recipes.title: Karage
recipes.description: Japanese karaage (from foodie_siulok). Use potato starch or corn starch, and rice bran oil.
ingredients: Potato starch or corn starch (for coating)
steps: Marinate the chicken with grated ginger, sake, white pepper, soy sauce, and optional salt/chicken powder.
Put the potato/corn starch into the cold oil first (首先將玉米粉放入冷油).
Before frying the second batch, add a little more corn starch (炸第二round之前，再落多少少玉米粉).

recipes.title: Viet chicken thigh marinate
steps: Combine frozen lemongrass, garlic powder, lemon, fish sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar with the chicken thighs and marinate.
